scientific_brief.flagship_statement: Exact quantum returns select the Born law: a constructed library of state-returning controls has quantum equilibrium as its only invariant Borel probability.
what_is_proved: For every prescribed connected graph of distinguishable three-dimensional particles, there exist fixed nonzero rank-one pair springs and one-body traps/control potentials whose globally defined configuration return maps have exactly one common invariant Borel probability: the Born measure at the selected preparation.
Nonlinear exact density rectangles in a reserved two-dimensional holding plane determine its marginal among all Borel laws, including atoms and singular continuous measures.

Corrected Gaussian return loops realize the full SO(3N) configuration group in whitened coordinates. One Gaussian plane marginal plus rotation invariance fixes the whole law by characteristic functions.

Physical one-body scalar controls implement exact quantum returns. A finite-dimensional endpoint correction preserves the relevant guidance curvature. No finite oscillator truncation supplies exactness.
An explicit finite damped nonlinear loop distinguishes a wider radial Gaussian: for R=16 and c=3/2, the mean shift is epsilon squared times C16 plus O(epsilon cubed), with C16 greater than 1/12.

Invariant-law uniqueness transports along admitted reversible globally defined preparation paths. Every positive-determinant linear configuration transport is reachable on the engineered network. Under ideal final-coordinate readout, no hysteresis under all library returns is equivalent to Born equilibrium.

For the specified lazy inverse-balanced independent randomized controller, all absolutely continuous laws converge to equilibrium in total variation. A law with singular mass s has limiting TV distance s. No uniform rate or spectral gap is asserted.

Every finite n obeys TV(mu_n,gamma) at least 2 to the power minus n times TV(mu_0,gamma), excluding exact finite reset unless the input was equilibrium. Independent almost-surely-finite stopping leaves a strictly positive smooth countermodel bias.

A countable finite-word common kernel cannot universally reset every smooth strictly positive bounded relative density to one nonatomic law. This covers suitable adaptive command choices without claiming impossibility for all preparation architectures.
Retained command history obeys D(mu_0||gamma)=D(mu_n||gamma)+I(Z_n;W_n) and implements a physical inverse echo recovering the initial pointwise configuration.

Appendix A extends Gaussian SO(A) holonomy to general positive connected fixed quadratic networks with unrestricted finite block-local traps, without weak-coupling or commensurate-frequency assumptions on the original device. It does not extend the nonlinear uniqueness theorem to arbitrary isotropic coupling.
scope_to_keep_explicit: Invariance of an actual preparation law under the full return library is a separate statistical premise; the construction plus unique invariant law does not derive that premise.
Nonlinear all-Borel uniqueness uses engineered directional interactions and a reserved plane. The broader Gaussian-only result is not all-Borel uniqueness for generic interacting networks.
All chosen protocols have finite resources, but the complete library has no common amplitude or description-complexity ceiling.
The randomized controller is externally controlled and uses a fresh independent classical command tape. It is not an autonomous microscopic source/clock/register construction.
Ideal final-position readout is a stated operational assumption; additional detector/apparatus coordinates require their own joint preparation law.
No physical Born-law initialization, universal arbitrary-law finite reset, independent repeated trials, thermal heat estimate, or cross-state statistical assignment is supplied.
